features.name: p1_log_position
features.description: Log-scaled position of P1 within the fold observed P1 range; compresses very large counts into a 0-1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces leverage from extreme P1 values while keeping monotonic ordering for a linear margin.

features.name: p_core_share_projection
features.description: Weighted centered projection of dense P shares P5p1, P15p1, and P16p2, clipped to 0-1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an approximate linear projection of high-prevalence P components, useful when small coordinated shifts matter.

features.name: p_sparse_share_burden
features.description: Composite severity of sparse P shares P6p2, P15p3, P18p2, and P27p4 scaled by observed upper endpoints.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts several low-frequency spikes into one smooth severity coordinate, reducing reliance on many separate thresholds.

features.name: p_mid_band_intensity
features.description: Average normalized intensity of medium-frequency P components P11p4 and P14p9.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures middle-band P variation as a single bounded coordinate with stable scaling.

features.name: p15_internal_contrast
features.description: Ratio-like contrast between P15p3 and P15p1; high values indicate the smaller P15 component is large relative to the dominant P15 component.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes within-group imbalance in a form that is nearly linear after bounding.

features.name: p16_vs_p15_gap_score
features.description: Centered score for the gap P16p2 - P15p1, shifted and clipped to a bounded scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a signed contrast transformed onto a common scale, helping the margin use relative differences.

features.name: h10_shortfall_score
features.description: Square-root shortfall of H10p1 from its upper endpoint, scaled by the fold observed span.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns a near-ceiling variable into a continuous deficit measure that spreads values away from saturation.

features.name: h_sparse_pressure
features.description: Weighted severity of H2p2, H8p2, and H18pA after scaling each by its observed upper endpoint.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates several H-side pressure indicators into one robust weighted composite.

features.name: h40_h13_balance_projection
features.description: Composite of H40p4 midrange balance and H13p1 intensity on a bounded 0-1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a bounded nonlinear projection of H40 midrange balance and H13 level for direct margin use.

features.name: cross_p_h_sparse_interaction
features.description: Square-root interaction between sparse P burden and H pressure, normalized to a bounded scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth interaction term so coordinated P and H sparsity can affect the margin linearly.

features.name: profile_coherence_judgment
features.description: 0-1 semantic score for how coherently the P and H proportions vary together in a row, considering fold ranges; 0 means many isolated extremes, 1 means a smooth mutually consistent profile.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact nonlinear assessment of cross-column consistency that a linear margin can use directly.

features.name: distributional_atypicality_judgment
features.description: 0-1 semantic severity score for unusual multivariate shape compared with fold summaries; 0 means ordinary across most columns, 1 means highly atypical across several columns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an interpretable anomaly-like coordinate, helping margins respond to rare but coherent patterns.
